name: Payment Script Guard
description: Keep an inventory of every script on your Magento checkout with a justification for each (PCI DSS 4.0.1 requirement 6.4.3) and get alerted when a script or the page's security headers change (requirement 11.6.1). Catches injected card skimmers. Works with Luma, Hyvä and one-step checkouts.
shortDescription: PCI DSS 4.0.1 checkout script inventory and skimmer detection (6.4.3 and 11.6.1)

features.title: Every checkout script, found automatically
features.text: A tiny reporter on your payment pages lists every script file and inline script, including scripts injected after the page loads and removed straight away, the way card skimmers hide.

features.title: Authorize with a written justification
features.text: Approve or reject each script with a business reason, as PCI DSS 6.4.3 asks. Your own store's files are authorized automatically; every decision is logged with the admin's name.

features.title: Tamper detection that knows your deployments
features.text: Every hour each file is compared with its approved SHA-384 hash. Your store's files are read from disk: a change after a deployment is accepted, a change without one is a critical alert.

features.title: Skimmer domains can't hide in inline code
features.text: Inline scripts are fingerprinted by their code and the domains they reference, so per-customer data doesn't create noise, but a new exfiltration domain always raises an alert.

features.title: Security header watch
features.text: Records the Content-Security-Policy and other security headers of your payment pages and alerts you when they change (PCI DSS 11.6.1).

features.title: Email alerts and a report for your assessor
features.text: Grouped email alerts, an admin notice and activity log, and a one-click CSV of the full inventory with justifications and hashes for your PCI assessment.
